text:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a 'slice gating' approach to GA gating for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. I want a compact set of pass/fail gates (SLA, docs parity, oncall, billing) we can use for weekend go/no-go.

ev...: Can you share the latest perf baselines? Need p95 and failure rates for the last 48h.

sandeep (Eng): Rolling canary for Dedicated will need the new autoscaler tweaks — estimate 2 dev days + 1 ops day. I can own the change if @evan signs off on monitoring hooks.

jess (Docs): Docs parity question: do we require full step-by-step install for Private GA or a supported quickstart + detailed ops runbook? I'd prefer quickstart + runbook for v1.

samir (Support): Runbook and escalation: we need 1) triage steps 2) severity mapping to Pager rotations and 3) billing credit rubric. Suggest we reuse the pilot playbook but formalize SLA credits.

maria: Proposal for gating checklist (pass/fail):
- SLA defined and tested for each deployment type
- Key doc surfaces: Quickstart, Runbook, Troubleshooting, Billing FAQ
- Oncall rota and escalation validated
- Pricing/rate-card available and QA'd
- Canary/pilot with >=3 customers or synthetic parity tests

ev... (SRE): Monitoring hooks: must have synthetic checks (query + generate), tracing enabled, and token-level cost alerts. I ran a smoke run: 95th latency for test slice = 280ms (Hosted), 140ms (Dedicated). Error rate < 0.3%.

deploy-bot: Preflight results — smoke-suite v2026-03-19:
- perf-baseline: PASS (p95 within target)
- canary-smoke: PASS
- infra-lint: WARN (missing autoscaler annotation on ds/private)

sandeep (Eng): Autoscaler annotation fix is small; I'll push a patch today and request @evan to kick a canary.

jess (Docs): If we go quickstart+runbook, I need reviewer names for Private. @sandeep, can you add the config snippets and a minimal example that I can copy?

samir (Support): For pricing readiness: we need a simple rate-card draft and examples for invoices, chargeback, and overage handling. Can the FinOps template be adapted?

maria: I'm suggesting concrete SLO table we gate on — please review and push objections now: 

```
Tier | p95 latency | Uptime | Support SLA
Hosted | <= 300ms | 99.9% | Standard (24h)
Dedicated | <= 180ms | 99.95% | Priority (4h)
Private | <= 180ms | 99.95% | Enterprise (1h)
```

These are the minimums. If monitoring shows sustained violations in staging, fail the gate.

ev... (SRE): Agree on monitoring; add synthetic test failure alerts to paging rules. Also need a 'graceful-degrade' fallback policy documented so customers don't see 500s during overload.

sandeep (Eng): For rollback/compat: quantized model will have a fallback to fp16 variant. I'll document the rollback command and add to runbook.

jess (Docs): I'll draft the Quickstart + Runbook pages by EOD Wednesday. Reviewers: @sandeep @evan @samir.

samir (Support): I'll own the playbook and the severity->credit matrix. Can we run a 2-week staged pilot with 2 internal customers + 1 external pilot? Prefer external be in dedicated mode.

maria: Yes. Pilot config: Dedicated pilot for latency-sensitive customer, Hosted pilot for broad coverage. Goal: detect operational issues and billing edge cases.

ev... (SRE): One open question: SLA measurement provider — use our telemetry + backup from Prometheus long-term. Need clear definitions in SLA doc for 'uptime' (control plane vs. data plane).

sandeep (Eng): I'll add the control/data plane split to the runbook and the feature flags to disable routing to Private if connectivity breaks.

jess (Docs): Also adding a 'what-to-expect' page for customers that explains performance variability during rollouts.

maria: Action items + owners (due dates):
- Autoscaler annotation fix -> @sandeep, due today
- Canary run + synth checks -> @evan, due tomorrow
- Quickstart + Runbook draft -> @jess, due Wed EOD
- Support playbook + credit rubric -> @samir, due Thu
- Rate-card draft -> @maria (I'll coordinate with FinOps), due Fri
- Pilot enrollment list -> @product-ops (I'll ping separately), start next Mon

ev... (SRE): I'll update the monitoring playbook with paging rules and add synthetic dashboards.

sandeep (Eng): Patch ready in a branch, will open PR once deploy pipeline is green.

maria: If everyone hits their dates, we can do a small-probation GA next week. If any gate fails, we hold and triage. Thanks all — ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
